comments.text:
The Gyro face wasn't permanent. 
This happens when you visit another town by doing the memory card swap mechanic where your character will be saved on the game's ram, you swap memory cards to the other town and it loads your character and items into the town.
Now if you don't save and reset/turn off power, the character data in the ram is lost. Your inventory is gone and your face is turn into that, but only for that playthrough. Your face will return to normal on the next playthtough.
But the inventory you had will not be recovered.
